column4: Summary
column5: Description

column4: E01 · Project mobilisation, governance and kickoff scope confirmations
column5:
The project is mobilised with a named lead, agreed governance, a shared backward-scheduled plan and written answers to every kickoff-level contract risk.

Phase: Initiate

column4: E02 · Discovery workshops and solution design
column5:
Current processes are documented and the Customer has signed a solution design covering entities, workflows, matching tolerances, payments, SSO and reports.

Phase: Discover

column4: E03 · Platform configuration for three entities
column5:
The sandbox tenant is configured to the signed design for all three entities, with workflows, matching, payments and reports passing internal review.

Phase: Configure

column4: E04 · Oracle NetSuite integration
column5:
Vendors, POs, receipts, GL accounts and approved bills sync with NetSuite, and payment status posts back, all proven in the NetSuite sandbox.

Phase: Integrate

column4: E05 · Okta SAML single sign-on
column5:
Harbor users sign in to the Platform through Okta SAML SSO.

Phase: Integrate

column4: E06 · Historical vendor data migration
column5:
Agreed historical vendor data is cleansed, loaded and reconciled in sandbox. No historical invoices or payment history are migrated.

Phase: Migrate

column4: E07 · Internal QA and user acceptance testing
column5:
The configured Platform has passed internal QA and Customer UAT under the agreed acceptance rules.

Phase: Test

column4: E08 · Administrator and end-user training
column5:
Up to 10 Harbor administrators are trained and recorded end-user videos are available.

Phase: Train

column4: E09 · Production cutover and go-live
column5:
All three entities are live in production on or before January 15, 2027.

Phase: Launch

column4: E10 · Hypercare, support handoff and closure
column5:
The solution is stable after 30 days of hypercare, Harbor is handed to standard support, and the project is closed.

Phase: Hypercare
